question: Can TerraVoce archive an open-data water-use proxy and score a prediction made before acquiring its target?
territory: Awash, Ethiopia: experimental rectangle near Wonji; not a verified farm boundary or the whole basin
areaStatus: demonstration-only; present land use and irrigation must be checked locally
statistic: area-weighted mean of native pixels intersecting the rectangle; no upsampling
days: actual Gregorian dekad length; multiply daily mean by days for a period total
forecastMethod: persistence: target AETI daily mean equals last history AETI daily mean
forecastInputs: history only; seal prediction before target acquisition
success: reproducible provenance, source units and scoring; this one round cannot establish forecasting skill
targetNature: FAO remote-sensing model estimate, not a field measurement
historicalAvailability: current revisions are used; original publication availability in 2024 is not reconstructed
irrigationAttribution: not established; AETI minus rainfall is not measured irrigation or river depletion
licenseScope: retain publisher attribution and source-specific license metadata; do not assume the repository code license covers source data
